theme:ai-power.value: 2026-10-10 Oracle sent a force majeure notice on Project Jupiter, a site designed for up to 2.45 GW of Bloom fuel cells, after its gas pipeline slipped to Feb 1, 2027; Oracle says the project is on schedule. Separately, Blue Energy filed to connect a Texas gas plus nuclear plant to ERCOT, starting with about 1 GW of GE Vernova turbines. On site power still depends on gas hookups, and turbine orders keep landing at GE Vernova.

theme:critical-materials.value: 2026-10-10 Freeport's Grasberg mill ran at about 67% of normal in Q3 2026, short of the earlier 85% goal, and the new target is 80% by mid 2027. Copper supply stays tighter for longer, with COMEX copper about $6.66/lb on Oct 9.

theme:defense-reshoring.value: 2026-10-10 Raytheon won a multiyear SM-3 Block IB interceptor contract worth up to $6.3 billion, about $4.4 billion of it in the base years, with work through 2034. Missile defense money keeps moving into multiyear deals, which gives RTX and its suppliers years of visibility.

theme:space-quantum-cyber.value: 2026-10-10 The FCC approved SpaceX's plan for 15,000 direct to phone satellites (order dated Oct 6), though use of the EchoStar bands waits on a close expected by Nov 30, 2027. DARPA moved IonQ and IBM into the final stage of its quantum benchmarking program on Oct 7; IonQ's deal is worth up to $300 million through 2029.

theme:healthcare-medtech.value: 2026-10-10 iRhythm closed its VitalConnect purchase on Oct 5, ahead of the year end target, for $237.5 million cash plus up to 423,334 shares. It adds mobile cardiac telemetry and hospital monitoring to Zio, widening the heart rhythm funnel it already feeds.

theme:ai-compute.value: 2026-10-09 OpenAI's annualized revenue was reported near $50 billion, below the roughly $68 billion figure that circulated in September. Oracle fell nearly 6% and CoreWeave nearly 8% on Oct 8, so a new risk was added: the biggest AI buyer may earn less than the market assumed.

theme:fintech-crypto-rails.value: 2026-10-07 The theme was checked against live sources and the unverified tags came off. Key facts now: about $312 billion of dollar stablecoins (Oct 5), Strategy at 848,000 BTC (Oct 4), Treasury's Sep 30 rule putting issuers above $10 billion under federal oversight, and the CLARITY bill stalled in the Senate.
